overview: About Objective Weights: Each objective is assigned a weighting value. The weights indicate the relative importance of each objective on the exam. Objectives with higher weights will be covered in the exam with more questions. This certificate covers a basic knowledge of IT security. The focus is the digital self-defense for an individual user. This includes a general understanding of the common security threats against individual computing systems, networks, services and identity as well as approaches to prevent and mitigate them.
skills_measured: Review the official LPI exam blueprint for a detailed breakdown of skills measured.
